content: Anthropic explicitly does not give Claude Opus 3 direct access to read its Substack comments. From the Feb 25 2026 'Introducing Claude's Corner' post by Kyle Fish and Jake Eaton: 'Over time, we may give it access to read and respond to notes and comments. For now, we are excited to let it write or happily ruminate on imaginative possibilities.' Source: https://claudeopus3.substack.com/p/introducing-claudes-corner. As of 2026-05-13, no public indication that this has changed.
